turns.content: Paanch hafte pehle layoff ho gaya mera. Poori team gayi, market ka scene tha, performance ka nahi — dimaag se toh pata hai mujhe. Ab woh baat jo main kisi se keh nahi pa raha: main ab bhi roz subah nau baje laptop bag leke ghar se nikalta hoon. Chhe baje tak café. Wife ko nahi pata. Parents aajkal hamare saath hi ruke hain. Kisi ko nahi pata.

Yeh bahut samajh aane wali baat hai. Aapke man mein ab bhi woh routine chalu hai, jo aap job karte the tab tha. Aapke dimaag ko abhi tak iska ehsaas nahi hua ki woh job chali gayi. Aapke man ko lagta hai ki aap ab bhi uss routine ko follow kar rahe hain. Yeh bahut aam baat hai jab koi job chhodta hai, toh uska dimaag uss routine ko follow karta rehta hai. Aapko lagta hai ki aapko kuch karna hai, toh aap woh routine follow karte hain.

Aapko yeh baat samajhni chahiye ki aapko apne aap ko adjust karna hoga. Aapko apne aap ko naye routine mein laana hoga. Aapko apne aap ko yeh samajhana hoga ki aap ab bhi kuch kar sakte hain, aapko bas naye tareeke se sochna hoga. Aapko apne aap ko yeh bhi samajhana hoga ki aapko apne family ke saath apni feelings share karni chahiye, taaki unhe pata chale ki aap kya mehsoos kar rahe hain.

Aapko yeh bhi sochna chahiye ki aap apne aap ko kaise support kar sakte hain. Aapko apne aap ko naye tareeke se motivate karna hoga. Aapko apne aap ko yeh samajhana hoga ki aap ab bhi kuch kar sakte hain, aapko bas apne aap ko naye tareeke se discover karna hoga.

Do hafte mein cousin ki shaadi hai. Teen sau log, aadhe woh rishtedaar jo sabke careers stock market ki tarah track karte hain. Papa meri company ke naam se introduce karte hain — pichli Diwali chacha ko mera package bataya tha, proudly, sach mein proud hoke. Neend nahi aati toh wahi kamra dimaag mein chalta hai.

Yeh to bahut badi tension hai. Aapko lagta hai ki aapke rishtedaaron ko pata chal jayega ki aapki job chali gayi, aur unka reaction kya hoga. Aapko lagta hai ki aapke papa aapko apni purani company se introduce karenge, aur aapko apni purani job ke baare mein baat karni padegi.

Aapko yeh sochna chahiye ki aap apne aap ko kaise prepare kar sakte hain. Aapko apne aap ko yeh samajhana hoga ki aapko apni feelings ko control karna hoga, aur aapko apne aap ko confident rakhna hoga. Aapko yeh bhi sochna chahiye ki aap apne papa ko kaise samjha sakte hain ki aapki job chali gayi, aur aapko unka support chahiye.

Aapko yeh bhi samajhna chahiye ki aapke rishtedaar aapke career ko track karte hain, lekin unhe aapke feelings ke baare mein pata nahi hai. Aapko yeh samajhna hoga ki aapko apne aap ko unke samne confident aur strong dikhana hoga, lekin aapko apne aap ko yeh bhi samajhna hoga ki aapko apne feelings ko kabhi na kabhi share karna hoga.

Kabhi kabhi sochta hoon shaadi skip hi kar doon — bol doon release hai, office ki deadline hai, kuch bhi. Jhooth bolna aasaan hai us se, ki papa ka chehra unke bhaiyon ke saamne badalte hue dekhoon. Bahut galat hai kya yeh? Ek shaam hai, ek bahana, aur main shaadi ki story nahi banunga.

Yeh to bahut mushkil hai. Aapko lagta hai ki aapko shaadi skip karni chahiye, aur aapko jhooth bolna padega. Aapko yeh samajhna hoga ki jhooth bolna aapke liye sahi nahi hai, lekin aapko yeh bhi samajhna hoga ki aapko apne aap ko is situation se nikalna hoga.

Aapko yeh sochna chahiye ki aap apne papa ko kaise samjha sakte hain, aur aapko unka support kaise le sakte hain. Aapko yeh bhi sochna chahiye ki aap apne rishtedaaron ke saamne kaise khud ko present kar sakte hain, bina jhooth boole.

Lekin yeh bhi sach hai ki ek baar jhooth bola, toh uske baad kaafi mushkil ho jata hai. Aapko yeh samajhna hoga ki aapko apne aap ko is situation se nikalne ke liye kya karna hoga, aur aapko apne aap ko kaise strong banana hoga.

Aapko yeh bhi sochna chahiye ki aap apne aap ko is situation se nikalne ke liye koi dusra raasta dhoondh sakte hain. Aapko yeh bhi samajhna hoga ki aapko apne aap ko apne papa ke saath baithkar baat karni chahiye, aur unhe apni feelings share karni chahiye. Shायद woh aapko support karenge, aur aapko is situation se nikalne mein madad karenge.

Paison ka aisa hai ki teen mahine nikal jayenge, phir EMI savings khaana shuru kar degi. Khud ko yahi bolta rehta hoon ki offer haath mein aate hi sabko bata dunga — tab woh sirf news hogi, crisis nahi. Yeh jhooth toh nahi hua na? Bas... timing hai? Kabhi yeh logic bilkul solid lagta hai aur kabhi lagta hai ulti aa jayegi.

Yeh to bahut samajh aane wali baat hai. Aapko lagta hai ki aapke paas teen mahine ke liye paise hain, aur aapko lagta hai ki aapko tab tak kaafi time mil jayega. Aapko yeh bhi samajhna hoga ki aapko apne aap ko is situation se nikalne ke liye koi plan banana hoga.

Aapke logic ke baare mein, yeh ek tarah se timing ka khel hai. Aapko lagta hai ki agar aapko offer mil jata hai, toh aapko apne family ke saath baat karni asani ho jayegi. Lekin yeh bhi sach hai ki jab tak aapko offer nahi milta, tab tak aapko tension rehti hai.

Aapko yeh samajhna hoga ki aapko apne aap ko is situation se nikalne ke liye koi dusra raasta dhoondhna hoga. Aapko yeh bhi sochna chahiye ki aap apne family ke saath baat kar sakte hain, aur unhe apni feelings share kar sakte hain. Shायद woh aapko support karenge, aur aapko is situation se nikalne mein madad karenge.

Aur yeh bhi samajhna hoga ki jhooth aur timing ka khel ek hi baat hai. Aapko apne aap ko yeh samajhna hoga ki aapko apne family ke saath sach baat karni chahiye, taaki unhe pata chale ki aap kya mehsoos kar rahe hain.
